title: MVR-Data
description: An Arrow-based multi-vector data format with matching C++20 and native Python APIs for schemas, manifests, readers, writers, and package integrity.

chapters.title: MVR-Data
chapters.description: What MVR-Data provides today, its package model, and the current scope of its matching C++20 and native Python APIs.
overview: How Raw, Embedded, and ground-truth data fit together.
Which C++20 and native Python capabilities are available now.
Which semantic validation and Raw-payload features remain outside the current scope.

chapters.title: Getting Started
chapters.description: Configure the header-only C++20 library, link its CMake target, and read or build an MVR-Data package with Apache Arrow.
overview: Current prerequisites and build behavior.
How to consume the CMake interface target.
How to open, stream, materialize, build, and verify a package.

chapters.title: Python Binding
chapters.description: Build and use the native mvr_data package through the same public names as the C++ API and native PyArrow values.
overview: How to reproduce the supported Conda build environment and install a wheel.
How C++ Arrow objects cross the binding as native PyArrow values.
How API names, exceptions, streaming, and static typing behave in Python.

chapters.title: Data Format
chapters.description: The MVR-Data v1 package layout, Manifest contract, canonical Arrow schemas, integrity rules, and compatibility policy.
overview: The Raw, Embedded, and ground-truth Arrow layouts.

The path, integrity, and versioning requirements for format v1.

chapters.title: Schema API
chapters.description: C++ reference for constructing canonical MVR-Data Arrow schemas and converting Embedded vector dtypes.
overview: Factories for Raw, Embedded, and ground-truth schemas.
Validation of vector dimensions and Arrow numeric types.
Canonical manifest spellings for all supported vector dtypes.

chapters.title: Manifest API
chapters.description: C++ reference for loading validated manifests and reading typed package, table, vector, and extension metadata.
overview: Package-kind and table-role value types.

chapters.description: C++ reference for opening packages and reading validated Arrow record batches or materialized tables.

overview: Package metadata, Arrow IPC options, and completed-shard summaries.

chapters.title: Integrity API
